command:
$runnerSource = Get-Content -LiteralPath 'research\rootcheck\m2\reproduce.ps1' -Raw -Encoding UTF8
$bootstrapMatch = [regex]::Match($runnerSource, "(?ms)^\`$bootstrap = @'\r?\n(.*?)\r?\n'@")
if (-not $bootstrapMatch.Success) { throw 'Offline bootstrap not found' }
$guardedBootstrap = $bootstrapMatch.Groups[1].Value
$repoRoot = (Get-Location).Path
$scriptPath = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath 'research\rootcheck\m2\probes\supplementary_repeated_readiness.py').Path
$expectedHash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $scriptPath -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
$guardedBootstrap | & '.venv\Scripts\python.exe' -I -B - $repoRoot $scriptPath $expectedHash
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
guarded_bootstrap_source: Unmodified reproduce.ps1 Python here-string; extracted without executing the original runner again
